items.name: Aníbal ao Cubo 2025

venue.name: Escola Básica Aníbal César
venue.address: R. Estefano José Vanolli 941- São Vicente, Itajaí - SC, 88309-201

items.information:
Bem-vindos ao Aníbal ao Cubo 2025!

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba Inscrever. Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste vídeo.https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8

Favor ler o Regulamento da WCA antes da competição.

🇺🇸 Welcome to the Aníbal ao Cubo 2025!

Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the Register tab. If you have any problem with how to register, take a look at this video.
https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8

Please read the WCA Regulations before the competition.

items.information:
* Para los nuevos competidores, habra un pequeño tutorial de como competir y algunos consejitos sobre los temporizadores penalidades etc, etc. Favor de familiarizarse con el reglamento para un mayor conocimiento de los torneos y sus caracteristicas.
> [Reglamento Oficial](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)

* For new competitors, there will be a small tutorial on how to compete, how to use the timers, how penalties work, etc. Please familiarize yourself with the rules for more knowledge of the competition and how they are run. 
> [Official Regulation](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)

items.name: Arroios Summer 2025

venue.name: [Mercado de Culturas](https://jfarroios.pt/equipamentos/mercado-de-culturas/)
venue.address: Mercado de Culturas, R. Maria da Fonte, 1170-220 Lisboa

items.information:
Se vais competir pela primeira vez, certifica-te que lês todas as informações em [Informação Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArroiosSummer2025#55441-informacao-importante-important-information), *[ Perguntas Frequentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArroiosSummer2025#55442-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* e no [Regulamento WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
Se és associado da APS tens direito a um **desconto exclusivo de 20%**, sabe mais [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArroiosSummer2025#55445-associados-aps-aps-associates).
•
If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArroiosSummer2025#55441-informacao-importante-important-information), the *[FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArroiosSummer2025#55442-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* and the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
If you're an APS associate you can take advantage of an **exclusive 20% discount**, find out more [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArroiosSummer2025#55445-associados-aps-aps-associatess).
​
